title: Intelligent Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease Based on Machine Learning
abstract: This study is based on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative dataset and explores early detection and disease progression in Alzheimer's disease using clinical, biomarker, and brain-structure variables.
notes: Toy include example using multimodal ADNI-style evidence.

title: Automatic Speech Classifier for Mild Cognitive Impairment and Early Dementia
abstract: This paper studies speech-based classification for mild cognitive impairment and early dementia using linguistic and acoustic signals.
notes: Toy include example using speech-language evidence.

title: Drug Repurposing for Alzheimer's Disease Treatment
abstract: This paper identifies candidate drugs for Alzheimer's disease treatment using computational screening.
notes: Toy exclude example for treatment/drug discovery.
